channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Souhan: If it weren’t for bad luck, Twins would have no luck at all
item.description: Are the Twins cursed? That might be hyperbole, but a trend of injuries to key players is continuing this spring and dampening any hopes for success in 2026.

item.title: No. 22 Gophers women’s basketball clinches No. 4 seed in Big Ten tournament with 78-73 victory at Illinois
item.description: The Gophers finished the regular season with 13 Big Ten victories, their most since 1985, and earned a double bye in the conference tourney for the first time since 2018.

item.title: Minnesota man circles Lake Superior, finding climbs, islands, waterfalls and parks ripe for discovery
item.description: Rudi Hargesheimer has harnessed his love of trails and the North Shore to inspire other ‘Circle Tour’ travelers with often overlooked places.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves move ahead of Nuggets with 117-108 victory at Denver
item.description: The Wolves used a balance offense to avoid a season sweep by the Nuggets.

item.title: Demonstrators arrested outside Whipple Building
item.description: The Hennepin County Sheriff’s Office said deputies declared an unlawful assembly.

item.title: Roper: Why Minneapolis’ dreams for former Kmart site could take decades to materialize
item.description: Reopening Nicollet Avenue this year is merely the first step in what promises to be a lengthy build-out.

item.title: Minnesota Republicans are recalibrating on abortion after past election losses
item.description: Many are carefully crafting a message they hope won’t alienate an electorate that punished the GOP after Roe v. Wade was overturned.

item.title: ‘SNL’ spot a completely different kind of pressure for Wild’s Quinn Hughes
item.description: The defenseman was back in Minnesota for Sunday’s game, but he will return to New York on Monday for one more late-night television appearance on NBC.

item.title: How the sextortion scourge terrorizes teens in Minnesota and beyond
item.description: For the Bremseth family of Olivia, a suicide from sextortion left pain that “will never go away.” They hope sharing Carter’s story saves lives.

item.title: Three American troops killed in Iran attack
item.description: The U.S. and Israel pounded targets across Iran on Sunday, dropping massive bombs on its ballistic missile sites and wiping out warships as part of an intensifying military campaign following the killing of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
